gloss: getting through life; making one's way in the world

definitions.gloss: getting through life; making one's way in the world; social navigation
definitions.explanation: The skill or act of navigating social relationships and circumstances to survive and succeed in society.

examples.japanese: {世渡|よわた}りが{上手|じょうず}な{人|ひと}だ。
examples.english: They're someone who knows how to get by in the world.

examples.japanese: {世渡|よわた}りが{下手|へた}で{苦労|くろう}した。
examples.english: I had a hard time because I'm not good at social navigation.

examples.japanese: {厳|きび}しい{世|よ}の{中|なか}を{世渡|よわた}りしていく。
examples.english: Making one's way through a harsh world.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
{世|よ} (world, society) + {渡|わた}り (crossing, getting across) - crossing through the world/society.

USAGE:
Often used with:
・{上手|じょうず} - good at social navigation
・{下手|へた} - bad at social navigation

COLLOCATIONS:
・{世渡|よわた}りが{上手|じょうず} - good at getting by
・{世渡|よわた}りが{下手|へた} - not good at social navigation
・{世渡|よわた}り{上手|じょうず} - socially savvy person

RELATED:
・{処世術|しょせいじゅつ} - wisdom for getting through life
・{根回|ねまわ}し - behind-the-scenes preparation
